# Minnesota, Event Staffing Compliance

- **Minimum wage (2026):** $11.41/hour
- **Weekly overtime:** after 40 hours
- **Daily overtime:** none

No daily overtime rule, standard weekly overtime after 40 hours.

## Notable rules

- Minnesota state law sets overtime after 48h/week, but most event employers are FLSA-covered and owe federal overtime after 40h/week (the stricter rule applies)

## Classification

TempGuru classifies **all** workers in Minnesota as W-2 employees regardless of
state. Workers' compensation and general liability are included in the bill rate.
See [the W-2 model](../../w2-model.md).
